frozen_candidate.name: frozen_three_candidate_two_objective_comparisons
frozen_candidate.allocation_basis: Keep primary80; subtract8 symmetrically from the two original128 safety allocations to fund one additional16-call comparison. Divide the original objective error allowance equally between the two predetermined comparisons; no data-tuned threshold.
flow: Safety-check the original primary and initial incumbent using their assigned budgets.

If both pass, compare primary against incumbent on comparison block0 and retain the incumbent unless the primary dominates under the existing paired statistic and the new delta. If only one passes, that policy is the current winner.
Safety-check the existing third candidate even when the first two produced a winner; apply no added risk filter or new candidate selection.
If third passes and a winner exists, compare third against that winner on independent comparison block1; switch only on paired objective dominance.
If the first two both fail and third passes, deploy third without a target comparison. If third fails, retain any certified winner. If all fail, report no certified deployment.
Preserve numerical execution failures and already used calls through the existing failure-accounting path; do not patch or retry the model.
frozen_candidate.independence: Block1 must be independent of block0, search, and safety; common random numbers are shared only within each compared pair. Current helper uses a fixed stream tag, so calling it twice with the same seed would reuse samples. Prepare an explicit comparison block index and document its seed mapping.
frozen_candidate.reuse: Reuse verify_frozen_policy and the existing paired objective statistic. The old verify_frozen_shortlist early-return control flow requires a small dedicated adjustment.
frozen_candidate.tradeoff: Lower backup safety counts and stricter objective comparisons may reduce power. Original certificates cannot be inherited, and omissions cannot be counted as recovered successes.

reuse.safety: Exact same slot, point and seed, first80/120/120 rows. Recompute candidate certificates; do not inherit128-sample status.
reuse.comparison0: Reuse the original ordered primary/incumbent8+8 block only when required; recompute with delta .05/6.
reuse.comparison1: New independent block1 for third versus actual first-stage winner, only when both are safety-certified.
reuse.identity: Raw identity is geometry/task/verification_seed/stream/candidate_index or comparison_block_index/ordered points/replication/side. Budget and delta describe inference, not raw identity.
reuse.failure: Persist exact partial blocks and spending. Ordinary repeat is blocked; an explicit resume reuses every recorded prefix, including a half CRN pair, and buys only missing samples. No resampling or precision change.

budget.cumulative_note: Old physical spending remains charged, including unused last8 safety rows. Historical old plus new spending is not bounded by one candidate352 cap.

primary_analysis.secondary: Report change in AFTER-minus-POINT and FULL-minus-AFTER under old versus new terminal, plus native/GP/structural/STOP references; fixed histories mean this is terminal conversion, not new search learning.
primary_analysis.aggregation: Statistical unit geometry, not arm or pair. Report per-geometry differences, family directions, wins/ties/losses, contribution concentration and descriptive paired t intervals on explicitly stated available subsets.

mechanism.decomposition: For defined metric M: Mnew-Mold=(Mnew-MB)+(MB-Mold). First term is third challenging an existing winner; second is joint safety120 and stricter-delta change, retaining interactions.
mechanism.matched_diagnostics: Report128-to120 safety pass/fail flips and old/new block0 decisions only for actual matched candidates/streams; do not invent additive causal components or new variants.

barriers: Complete exact-prefix/block reuse adapter and deterministic budget/resume/metric checks before real execution. The35 previous checks do not validate cache reuse.
Use all215 frozen candidate inputs and preserve the216th search failure; no intermediate outcome-based truncation, new seeds, variants or precision patches.

decision: Assess certification, signed quality and actual spending jointly. Do not adopt automatically from this opened cohort, fill missing values, or attribute generic terminal gains to prior propagation. No further patch screening in this batch.
